<module id="div_16bit">
    <description>Implement a 16-bit divider where the dividend is 16-bit and the divider is 8-bit in combinational logic.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="A" width_description="[15:0]">Dividend input.</input>
        <input id="B" width_description="[7:0]">Divider input.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">Quotient output.</output>
        <output id="odd" width_description="[15:0]">Remainder output.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Extracts the higher bits of the dividend, compares them with the divisor, sets the quotient to 1 if the dividend bits are greater, otherwise set it to 0, and uses the difference as the remainder. Concatenates the remainder with the highest remaining 1-bit of the dividend, and repeats the process until all dividend bits are processed.</implementation>
    <task id="divide_task">
        <description>Task for performing division operation.</description>
        <input id="a_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Register for storing dividend value.</input>
        <input id="b_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register for storing divider value.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">Result of division operation.</output>
        <output id="odd" width_description="[15:0]">Remainder of division operation.</output>
    </task>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="result[0]" value="(a_reg[15:8] >= b_reg)? 1 : 0" />
        <assign id="odd[0]" value="(a_reg[15:8] >= b_reg)? (a_reg[15:8] - b_reg) : a_reg[15:8]" />
        <assign id="result[1]" value="(a_reg[14:7] >= b_reg)? 1 : 0" />
        <assign id="odd[1]" value="(a_reg[14:7] >= b_reg)? (a_reg[14:7] - b_reg) : a_reg[14:7]" />
        <assign id="result[2]" value="(a_reg[13:6] >= b_reg)? 1 : 0" />
        <assign id="odd[2]" value="(a_reg[13:6] >= b_reg)? (a_reg[13:6] - b_reg) : a_reg[13:6]" />
        <assign id="result[3]" value="(a_reg[12:5] >= b_reg)? 1 : 0" />
        <assign id="odd[3]" value="(a_reg[12:5] >= b_reg)? (a_reg[12:5] - b_reg) : a_reg[12:5]" />
        <assign id="result[4]" value="(a_reg[11:4] >= b_reg)? 1 : 0" />
        <assign id="odd[4]" value="(a_reg[11:4] >= b_reg)? (a_reg[11:4] - b_reg) : a_reg[11:4]" />
        <assign id="result[5]" value="(a_reg[10:3] >= b_reg)? 1 : 0" />
        <assign id="odd[5]" value="(a_reg[10:3] >= b_reg)? (a_reg[10:3] - b_reg) : a_reg[10:3]" />
        <assign id="result[6]" value="(a_reg[9:2] >= b_reg)? 1 : 0" />
        <assign id="odd[6]" value="(a_reg[9:2] >= b_reg)? (a_reg[9:2] - b_reg) : a_reg[9:2]" />
        <assign id="result[7]" value="(a_reg[8:1] >= b_reg)? 1 : 0" />
        <assign id="odd[7]" value="(a_reg[8:1] >= b_reg)? (a_reg[8:1] - b_reg) : a_reg[8:1]" />
        <assign id="result[8]" value="(a_reg[7:0] >= b_reg)? 1 : 0" />
        <assign id="odd[8]" value="(a_reg[7:0] >= b_reg)? (a_reg[7:0] - b_reg) : a_reg[7:0]" />
        <assign id="result[9]" value="0" />
        <assign id="odd[9]" value="0" />
        <assign id="result[10]" value="0" />
        <assign id="odd[10]" value="0" />
        <assign id="result[11]" value="0" />
        <assign id="odd[11]" value="0" />
        <assign id="result[12]" value="0" />
        <assign id="odd[12]" value="0" />
        <assign id="result[13]" value="0" />
        <assign id="odd[13]" value="0" />
        <assign id="result[14]" value="0" />
        <assign id="odd[14]" value="0" />
        <assign id="result[15]" value="0" />
        <assign id="odd[15]" value="0" />
    </logic_description>
</module>
